adaptive-thinking.notes: Page title and subtitle — positions adaptive thinking as the recommended way to use extended thinking.

zdr-note.notes: Zero Data Retention eligibility note for adaptive thinking feature.

adaptive-thinking-is-the-recommended-way.notes: Core definition paragraph; states Opus 4.7 rejects manual budget_tokens — key caveat and model-selection decision.

tip-performance-vs-budget-tokens.notes: Tip block: adaptive outperforms fixed budget_tokens for bimodal/agentic workloads; deprecated path noted.

supported-models.notes: Per-model availability table: Mythos (default), Opus 4.7 (only mode, 400 on enabled), Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6.

budget-tokens-deprecation-warning.notes: Warning: budget_tokens deprecated on Opus/Sonnet 4.6; older models require it.

how-adaptive-thinking-works.notes: Explains optional thinking, complexity evaluation, effort-level influence, and automatic interleaved thinking.

how-adaptive-thinking-works-interleaved.notes: Second sentence of the How it works section: adaptive auto-enables interleaved thinking between tool calls.

how-to-use-adaptive-thinking.notes: Intro sentence: set thinking.type to adaptive in the API request.

code-group-basic-adaptive.notes: Multi-language code examples for basic adaptive thinking request (Shell, CLI, Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, Ruby).

adaptive-thinking-with-the-effort-parame.notes: Intro + effort-level table: max/xhigh/high/medium/low behavior with thinking allocation.

code-group-effort-parameter.notes: Multi-language code examples for adaptive thinking combined with output_config.effort.

streaming-with-adaptive-thinking.notes: Intro sentence: adaptive thinking works with streaming via thinking_delta events.

code-group-streaming.notes: Multi-language streaming code examples for adaptive thinking.

adaptive-vs-manual-vs-disabled-thinking.notes: Comparison table: adaptive/manual/disabled configs, availability, and when-to-use guidance.

interleaved-thinking-availability-note.notes: Note block detailing interleaved thinking availability by mode and model, including Opus 4.6 limitation.

validation-changes.notes: Adaptive mode relaxes API validation: prior assistant turns don't need to start with thinking blocks.

prompt-caching.notes: Cache breakpoints preserved within adaptive mode; switching modes breaks message cache but not system prompts.

tuning-thinking-behavior.notes: Promptable triggering behavior; system prompt guidance can reduce or increase thinking frequency.

tuning-thinking-warning.notes: Warning: steering Claude to think less may reduce quality; measure impact before production deployment.

cost-control.notes: max_tokens is hard limit; effort is soft guidance; max/high effort may exhaust budget triggering stop_reason: max_tokens.

working-with-thinking-blocks.notes: Section intro: concepts apply to all extended-thinking models regardless of mode.

summarized-thinking.notes: Summarized thinking is default for Claude 4; Opus 4.7 and Mythos default to omitted; display must be set explicitly.

summarized-thinking-considerations.notes: Bullet-list caveats: billed for full tokens not summary tokens, verbose preamble behavior, separate summarization model.

summarized-thinking-sonnet37-note.notes: Sonnet 3.7 returns full thinking; full output for Claude 4 requires contacting sales.

controlling-thinking-display.notes: display field values: summarized (default older Claude 4) vs omitted (default Opus 4.7/Mythos); omitted improves streaming TTFT.

display-sdk-note.notes: SDK support gap: display not in type definitions; Python works transparently, TS needs assertion, others need raw HTTP.

omitted-thinking-considerations.notes: Omitted thinking reduces latency not cost; signature must be passed back unchanged; display invalid with disabled thinking.

signature-display-compatibility-note.notes: signature field is identical for summarized/omitted; switching display values between turns is supported.

opus-47-display-default-note.notes: Silent change: Opus 4.7 defaults display to omitted vs Opus 4.6 default of summarized; must set explicitly to restore.

display-omitted-code-reference.notes: Cross-reference to extended thinking page for display:omitted examples; adaptive uses type:adaptive not type:enabled.

thinking-encryption.notes: Encrypted signature field verifies thinking blocks generated by Claude when passed back to API.

thinking-encryption-tools-note.notes: Only strictly necessary to send thinking blocks back when using tools; otherwise can omit.

thinking-encryption-considerations.notes: Signature caveats: streaming delivery via signature_delta, longer in Claude 4, opaque, cross-platform compatible.

pricing.notes: What incurs charges: thinking tokens (output), thinking blocks in next request (input), standard text output.

pricing-system-prompt-note.notes: Specialized system prompt automatically included when extended thinking is enabled — implicit token cost.

pricing-summarized.notes: Token breakdown for summarized thinking: billed for full thinking tokens, not visible summary tokens; summary generation is free.

pricing-omitted.notes: Token breakdown for omitted display: same billed cost as summarized; visible thinking tokens are zero.

pricing-billing-warning.notes: Warning: billed count will not match visible token count — billed for full thinking process.

additional-topics.notes: Cross-references to extended thinking page: tool use, prompt caching, context window interactions with thinking.

next-steps.notes: Navigation cards to extended thinking and effort parameter pages.
